# ShortHand
> A tool built by a teacher for fast behavior tracking that turns classroom notes into parent-ready messages: in seconds.

## About
ShortHand was created by Gregory Lebed, a former RBT (Registered Behavior Technician) and current 3rd grade teacher, to solve the daily paperwork burden teachers face. It runs in the browser on any device with no app store download required. ShortHand is built specifically for classroom teachers (not administrators, not district IT) and is designed to be usable mid-lesson without interrupting instruction.

## Core Features
- Quick Note: log student behavior in under 5 seconds using voice-to-text or typing
- Parent Communication Log: maintain a timestamped record of every parent contact (calls, emails, meetings) so teachers always have documentation ready for conferences and IEP meetings
- AI Parent Messages: turn behavior notes into professional parent emails instantly
- Write Reports: auto-generate progress reports and report card comments from logged notes
- Behavior Tracking: review each student's note history and see an 8-week activity view to spot recent patterns
- Never Miss a Student: color-coded status rings show green within 8 days, amber at 9-15 days, and red at 16+ days
- Accommodations at a Glance: see every student's IEP, 504, and classroom accommodations in one place
- Ask ShortHand (Pro): ask a plain-language question and get a one-time answer pulled only from the notes a teacher has already logged, not a continuing chat and not connected to any outside data source
- Student Documentation Report (Pro): export a clean PDF of a student's dated, logged notes for a chosen period, a direct export of the teacher's own documentation, not an AI summary
- Meeting Prep Report (Pro): pulls a student's notes, recent parent communication, goals, and accommodations for a chosen period into one page, with a short AI summary that groups notes into themes without diagnosing or claiming trends

## Who It's For
- Elementary and middle school classroom teachers
- Special education teachers managing IEP documentation and behavior intervention plans
- Teachers who need a paper trail for parent communications and conferences
- Any K-12 educator who has ever walked into a parent meeting unprepared

## Problems It Solves
- "I can't remember the last time I contacted this parent": ShortHand logs every interaction with a timestamp
- "Writing progress reports takes my whole weekend": AI generates report card comments from your own notes
- "I need documentation for this IEP meeting": behavior trends and parent contact history in one place
- "I forgot to follow up with a parent": student alerts show who hasn't been checked on in days
- "I don't have time to write a professional email after a hard day": AI drafts it from your quick note

## Audience
K-12 teachers, primarily elementary school educators and special education teachers managing classroom behavior documentation, parent communication logs, and student reporting.

## Pricing
Currently in beta and free to join. No credit card required.
